mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return rate in the lowest quartile of FEDFUNDS is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% in 70% of instances but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and HOUST occurs in 60% of instances but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and rising), a CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting further rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and rising), CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 in 70% of instances but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes a recession and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS occurs in 60% of instances but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above its 12-month moving average in 70% of instances but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 100), a rising CPIAUCSL signals inflationary pressure from supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO < 100), CPIAUCSL rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances.
